page.overview:
Who is Retsu?

Ascetic Martial Artist/Monk (currently)|alignment=Good|relationship=Gouken (Friend) Ryu (Friend), Avatar (friend)

Retsu (烈, lit. "Furious") is a non-playable character from the Street Fighter series who first appeared in the original game of the same name game as one of the ten non-playable opponents.

Retsu was indefinitely excommunicated from his temple for using forbidden techniques, as well as his combative tendencies.

Retsu crossed paths with Ryu while the young fighter was on a training journey. The fight with Ryu made him change his ways, and after their fight, Retsu shared his yokan with Ryu.
